source_title: Nevada Department of Veterans Services: Veterans Service Officers
note: The department lists no office in this county. Call a veterans service officer at 775-321-4880, the number it lists for its Reno, Fallon, Elko and Winnemucca offices, or 702-224-6025 (Las Vegas), or use Ask a VSO on its website. Nevada Department of Veterans Services veterans service officers are accredited by VA and help with claims, pension, survivor benefits and appeals at no charge. The department says intake appointments are taking about 30 to 90 days to schedule.
